correctness.rationale: Legendre addition theorem makes the pure harmonic input positive semidefinite. Darboux P_m(cos u) for m=2n−2 has phase (2n−3/2)u−π/4; at u=πj/n this aliases modulo 2π to −3u/2−π/4. Uniform interior Darboux remainder and binomial concentration prove compact-interior √n H_n convergence, without claiming uniform endpoint behavior. Exact Bernstein beta integral and bounded sine Taylor error O(1/n), uniform |P_m|<=1, convert the normalized a0 to a weighted Riemann sum. Standard uniform Legendre envelope bounds √n|P_m(cos u)|sin u <=C sqrt(sin u), including endpoints by vanishing sine, permitting dominated integral limit. The beta-cosine integral equals π/(2sqrt(2)) and gives −sqrt(π)/(4sqrt(2)) (independently integrated to −0.313328534328875...). Schoenberg coefficient nonnegativity makes eventual negative a0 a fixed S² obstruction. No least cutoff claimed.
